_comment: FIXTURE SOURCE 2 of 2 — the advice fact-find. Invented client, invented circumstances. Nothing here corresponds to a real person. This file plays the role of the suitability questionnaire the client completed with a human adviser: it is authoritative for the client's OBJECTIVES, CAPACITY FOR LOSS and STATED risk profile, and for nothing else. It knows nothing about what the portfolio is worth — that is the custodian's job — and the split is the point. Two sources, one document, and every figure in the document has to say which one it came from.

responses.value: Draw a steady income from the portfolio from 2028, without reducing the capital in real terms.
Moderate. A fall of more than 20 percent would require deferring the 2028 income start.
Has held collective investments for 14 years. No derivatives, no structured products.
